full-push-proof.if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/') && needs.plan.outputs.tier == 'push' && needs.plan.outputs.coverage == 'full' && needs.build.result == 'success' && needs.checks.result == 'success' && (needs.plan.outputs.size_check != 'true' || needs.size-check.result == 'success') }}

nightly-proof.if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && (needs.plan.outputs.tier == 'nightly' || needs.plan.outputs.tier == 'all') && needs.plan.outputs.coverage == 'full' && needs.build.result == 'success' && needs.slow.result == 'success' && needs.size-check.result == 'success' }}
